about: Curated jeepney routes for Calamba bound trips. Flow, stops and boarding points come from Drei's local knowledge (Oct 21, 2026). Paths are road geometry from OSRM (OpenStreetMap) through the route's known stops, simplified to about 6 m; they are estimates of the jeepney's road, not GPS traces. Polylines use the Google encoded polyline format, precision 5, lat/lng, ordered from 'from' to 'to'. Fares come from js/fare-calc.js (LTFRB Region IV-A jeepney guide). Route stops list the role of each stop per direction: 'board', 'alight' or 'both' (a plain id means both); a direction set to false is not served. Transfers happen only where one jeep lets passengers off and the next one loads.

crossing-grand-terminal.name: Crossing Grand Terminal
crossing-grand-terminal.note: West side of National Highway 1, north of the Crossing triangle (Google plus code 6543+FR). Jeeps coming into Calamba pass here and let passengers off, then go on to SM Calamba. Not a transfer point.

sm-calamba-west.name: SM Calamba (Cinema side)
sm-calamba-west.note: Driveway on SM City Calamba's west side (SM City Calamba Bypass Road), by SM Cinema and Starbucks. Jeeps drop passengers here for SM; the Calamba-Tagaytay jeep terminal is here too (Google plus code 6533+8V4).

calamba-tagaytay-terminal.name: Calamba–Tagaytay Terminal
calamba-tagaytay-terminal.note: Jeep terminal by SM Cinema on SM City Calamba's west side, next to the drop-off (Google: 'Calamba-Tagaytay UV Terminal', plus code 6533+8V4). Jeeps to Tagaytay (and Tanauan) via Real load here.

sm-transport-terminal.name: SM Transport Terminal
sm-transport-terminal.note: East side of SM City Calamba, Inner Road (Google plus code 6534+3P). Jeeps to Halang load here.

routes.name: Sta. Rosa – Calamba
routes.notes: Comes south on National Highway 1 through Cabuyao. Passes Crossing Grand Terminal (passengers can get off there), then turns into SM's west driveway and drops passengers by SM Cinema / Starbucks. Going back north it loads at SM's west side. Board or get off anywhere along the highway.

routes.name: Los Baños (UPLB) – Calamba
routes.notes: Inbound only: comes on the National Highway through Halang, passes Crossing Grand Terminal first, then loops back to SM Calamba (Cinema side). The trip back to Los Baños is the calamba-uplb route.

routes.name: Calamba – Los Baños (UPLB)
routes.notes: Outbound to Los Baños on the National Highway through Halang (Drei: riding it to Halang is fine). Loading point at SM assumed to be SM Transport Terminal, like the Halang jeeps (to confirm).

routes.name: SM Calamba – Halang
routes.notes: Loads at SM Transport Terminal. Where it ends past Halang is not recorded yet; the path stops at Halang.

routes.name: Calamba – Tagaytay
routes.notes: Loads at the Calamba–Tagaytay Terminal by SM Cinema, leaves SM through the west driveway onto the highway (Real Road) and passes Real. Past Real the path follows Calamba-Tagaytay Road as OpenStreetMap routes it (rough near the SLEX interchange).

routes.name: Calamba – Tanauan
routes.notes: Passes Real on the way to Tanauan. Loading point assumed to be the Calamba–Tagaytay Terminal by SM Cinema (to confirm). Leaves SM through the west driveway. The path ends on Maharlika Highway past Turbina; the Batangas part comes later.
